## Appearance

Anne is a skinny girl with a pointed freckled face, a little pointed chin, and solemn, big gray eyes. She has red hair that she wears in long braids, which Streams behind her in a bright torrent when unbraided, though some consider it auburn or [Titian](../character/titian.md). At various points, her hair is dyed green, closely shingled, and eventually grows back into short, silky curls. She has ungracefully long, thin legs, stands taller than [Miss Barry](../character/josephine-barry.md), and displays a pale style with cheeks that flush faintly pink.

## Personality

A passionate and ambitious individual, she possesses a vivid imagination that frequently draws her into daydreams, though she is also described as heedless, impulsive, smart, and obedient. She holds strong aspirations, striving to become a teacher, emulate Mrs. [Allan](../character/allan.md), and attend [Redmond College](../codex/places.md#redmond-college) while actively pursuing the Avery scholarship through hard work. Her academic efforts are further driven by a desire to make [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) proud and a strong determination not to fail in front of [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md). Outside of her studies, she possesses a talent for storytelling and a praised singing voice. Her primary fears include going through the [Haunted Wood](../codex/places.md#haunted-wood) after dark.

## History

Born in [Bolingbroke](../codex/places.md#bolingbroke), [Nova Scotia](../codex/places.md#nova-scotia), Anne Shirley spent her early years as an orphan living with Mrs. [Thomas](../character/thomas-lynde.md), Mrs. [Hammond](../character/hammond.md), and at an asylum before being brought to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables). Though brought there by mistake instead of a boy, she was permitted to stay on probation with [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and [Matthew Cuthbert](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md). Her volatile temper led to a clash with Mrs. Rachel [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) over insults about her red hair, but [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) persuaded her to apologize. After making a deep lifelong vow of friendship with [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md), Anne faced a series of mishaps, including accidentally getting [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) drunk on currant wine and accidentally flavoring a cake for the new minister's wife with liniment. She also developed a bitter rivalry with classmate [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) after he teased her by calling her 'Carrots' and she broke a slate over his head. At school, Anne fell off a roof on a dare and broke her ankle, and she later dyed her hair green by mistake, forcing [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) to cut it off. During a dramatic boat reenactment, she had to be rescued from a bridge pile by [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), yet she maintained her refusal of his friendship. Anne joined Miss Stacy's advanced class to prepare for the Queen's [Entrance](../codex/places.md#entrance) examination, eventually tying for first place across the entire [Island](../codex/places.md#island) and earning a place at Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#queen-s-academy). While attending Queen's, she won the prestigious Avery scholarship, but her life changed drastically when [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) died suddenly following a bank failure.

## Quotes

> "Pretty well. I imagine a good deal, and that helps to pass the time. Of course, it’s rather lonesome. But then, I may as well get used to that."
>
> — Anne Shirley — [v1 CHAPTER X. Anne’s Apology P11](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0011)

> "I don’t get cross about other things; but I’m so tired of being twitted about my hair and it just makes me boil right over. Do you suppose my hair will really be a handsome auburn when I grow up?"
>
> — Anne Shirley — [v1 CHAPTER X. Anne’s Apology P43](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0043)

> "I love pretty things; and I hate to look in the glass and see something that isn’t pretty. It makes me feel so sorrowful—just as I feel when I look at any ugly thing. I pity it because it isn’t beautiful."
>
> — Anne Shirley — [v1 CHAPTER X. Anne’s Apology P45](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0045)

> "I love Green Gables already, and I never loved any place before. No place ever seemed like home. Oh, Marilla, I’m so happy. I could pray right now and not find it a bit hard."
>
> — Anne Shirley — [v1 CHAPTER X. Anne’s Apology P49](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0049)

> "Oh, Marilla, I’m frightened—now that it has come I’m actually frightened. What if she shouldn’t like me! It would be the most tragical disappointment of my life."
>
> — Anne Shirley — [v1 CHAPTER XII. A Solemn Vow and Promise P10](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0010)

### [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--diana-barry.md)

Anne and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) are bosom friends who pledged a solemn oath of eternal friendship upon meeting at [Orchard Slope](../codex/places.md#orchard-slope). The pair act as playmates who enjoy rowing on the pond together and attending school events. Their close bond has weathered several trials, including a temporary separation by Diana's mother after Anne nursed Diana's sister through an illness, as well as a brief disruption during a party where Anne broke her ankle.

### [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--gilbert-blythe.md)

Anne and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) maintain an intense academic rivalry, competing for top marks at school and during their advanced exam studies. Their relationship began with hostility after [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) pulled Anne's braid and called her 'Carrots,' causing her to smash a slate over his head and hold a persistent grudge against him. Despite [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) rescuing her from a leaking boat and harboring romantic feelings for her, Anne stubbornly rejected his offer of friendship, though she eventually harbored hidden regret and quiet forgiveness toward him.

### [Minnie May](../character/minnie-may.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--minnie-may.md)

[Minnie May](../character/minnie-may.md) is [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) Barry's little sister, whom Anne saved by successfully treating her through the night when she fell severely ill with croup.

### [Phillips](../character/phillips.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--phillips.md)

Mr. [Phillips](../character/phillips.md) is Anne's school teacher. Their relationship is marked by tension, as he publicly punishes her by making her stand at the blackboard and forcing her to sit next to [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), leading Anne to temporarily refuse to attend his school.

### [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--rachel-lynde.md)

[Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) and Anne initially started as enemies after Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) made blunt remarks about Anne's red hair, causing Anne to fly into a fiery rage and shout at her. However, after Anne delivered a dramatic apology at Matthew's prompting, Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) completely forgiven her, and the two moved past their hostility to maintain a friendly relationship.
